source_title: Fertilizer Recommendation Guide-2024 — general residual/adjustment rules
source_page_or_table: General fertilizer adjustment bullets (~p.49)
transform_notes: Narrative rules summarized with source wording preserved where critical.
adjustments: After potato (if full K used): subsequent crops K may be reduced 30-40%.
Rabi crops after T. Aman: 50% S dose except oil seed, maize, potato and vegetables which receive full S.
Zn: maize, potato as 2nd/3rd crop should receive 50% Zn if prior rules apply; calcareous AEZs 10-13 need Zn on rabi and kharif.
Boron: rabi crops should receive boron once a year.
Rainfed yield reduction could be 15% rice/jute, 20% potato/sugarcane (partial sentence in source continues).
Organic manure: adjust chemical fertilizer accounting 50% mineralization.
